title: Kitchen water-loss notification
sourceText:
From: Avery Lane <avery.lane@example.com>
Subject: Report a new kitchen water loss
On November 12, 2026, a supply hose leaked in my kitchen and damaged the cabinet base. My Meridian Property policy is MP-10021. Please open a claim. I have not reported this incident before. You may contact me at avery.lane@example.com.

attachments.text: Synthetic attachment transcript: supply hose isolated and replaced on 2026-11-12; cabinet base has water damage. Customer: Avery Lane. No personal injury reported.

extracted.lossDescription: Kitchen supply-hose leak damaged the cabinet base.

title: Garage damage notification
sourceText:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@example.com>
